title: Louisiana Sales Tax: Rates, Rules & Compliance Guide
summary: Complete guide to Louisiana sales tax: 5% state rate, local rates up to 8.5%, SaaS taxability, registration via LaTAP and Remote Sellers portal, and deadlines.
body_markdown:
**Louisiana Sales Tax Quick Facts**


**Louisiana sales tax rate:**


5%


**Max combined state sales tax rate:**


13.5%


**Economic nexus threshold:**


$100,000 in gross sales in the previous or current calendar year


**What sales count toward the threshold:**


Gross sales, including marketplace sales


**Tax authority:**


[Louisiana Department of Revenue](https://revenue.louisiana.gov/)


**Tax portal:**


[LaTAP](https://latap.revenue.louisiana.gov/_/) &[Louisiana Sales and Use Tax Commission for Remote Sellers](https://remotesellers.louisiana.gov/) (for out-of-state businesses)


**SaaS taxable:**


Yes


**Administration difficulty:**


3/5
